name: Parts lock into the whole
look: The stage opens on one huge word alone (a year, a figure, a name). It steps back into its place in the product's own interface while the interface's panels fly in from the four edges and lock into one whole screen; then layers of detail ink in one by one (the data, the team's comments, an agent's edit), and the finished screen steps aside into a column at least 580px wide beside the heading and a short spec list. No caption under the screen.
reduced: The finished screen beside the heading and spec list.
phone: The finished composition: the screen with its toolbar and main pane, the spec under it.

needs.ui: the product's real screen as HTML cut along its own panels (a toolbar, a sidebar, a main pane, an inspector), 2 to 4 detail layers marked data-layer
needs.words: one word that sits in the screen's title, a heading and 3-4 spec rows

never: an illustration drawn for the page or a screenshot cut into tiles; a screen that cannot be cut into meaningful parts; a caption under the screen; a hardware, game or any page whose screen is not the product itself (it assembles the product's own UI, so it runs on software only)
